title: The **Prime-Based Quantum Hyperbolic Multiplicity Algorithm (PBQHMA)** introduces **prime-number encoding** into the **hyperbolic functions** used in **quantum systems** and their application to **quantum multiplicity**. Hyperbolic functions (such as **sinh**, **cosh**, **tanh**) arise naturally in many areas of physics, including **quantum mechanics**, **quantum field theory**, and **statistical mechanics**, particularly in problems involving exponential growth, decay, and wave functions in quantum systems. **Multiplicity**, in this context, refers to the repetition or combination of quantum states or processes, which can affect how quantum states evolve, interact, or contribute to quantum phenomena like **superposition** or **entanglement**.
